caveats: Earlier validation buckets UTC; this producer uses Europe/Prague. All included closes have identical day labels in this input.
Index uses USD 100000 reference capital, not opening mark-to-market equity; first point is the close of the epoch day.
Roster pointer signed flag is false, preserved as the existing attribution reference; no new deploy authorization inferred.
Last-deal timestamp is the last included governed close; full export is read through its final observed day.
